# Lawyer
1. Lawyers report directly to the Head of Personnel.
2. Lawyers must report to court when summoned for a trial, and are expected to provide legal counsel to their clients.
3. When arbitrating petty disputes, Lawyers are expected to be impartial and provide fair mediation to all parties involved.
4. For sentences longer than 15 minutes, but not those classified as Capital Crimes, prisoners may request a Lawyer to obtain a plea deal. In these cases, Internal Affairs Agents will act as representatives of Security.
4. Unless requested by a member of Security or Command, Lawyers are not expected to involve themselves in the legal matters of prisoners, and must defer to Internal Affairs Agents in these matters.
5. The Head of Personnel retains the right to dismiss a Lawyer from their position immediately, without need for justification.
